status: DQN complete — neural Q-function validated on CartPole
key_finding: DQN with 2-layer MLP (64 hidden), experience replay, and target network learns CartPole from 14→47 avg reward in 1000 episodes. Function approximation replaces Q-table lookup, enabling continuous state spaces. Three innovations over tabular Q-learning: (1) Neural network generalizes across similar states, (2) Experience replay provides i.i.d. samples breaking temporal correlation, (3) Target network prevents moving-target bootstrapping. Bug lesson: gradient double-scaling (batch normalization in both gradient computation AND backward pass) silently prevents learning.
